items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I was just as baffled by people like Bartok and Stravinsky; how did they do it? How can it be that someone could be that good?

ctx.x: Perhaps at a certain time I think that's true.
I think what's important is we associated with our associates; it's a social art, a very social art. You can't do it alone, you can't do it locked in a closet.
By the way, you mentioned something about Bartok the other day and I'd like you to clarify that, because it doesn't sound like Bartok to me.
